title: Flat terms, strict interval support and K-flatness of a model
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an essentially small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$, let $A$ be a commutative ring, and use ordinary fixed-$A$ module sheaves on this site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For integers $a,b$ and a cochain complex $P$ of these sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], define $\operatorname{modelProperties}(J,A,a,b,P)$ to mean the conjunction: every $P^q$ is flat, that is, tensoring with $P^q$ is exact [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]; $P^q$ is a zero object whenever $q<a$ or $b<q$; and $P$ is K-flat, meaning tensoring it with any acyclic complex is acyclic [def-pc-kflat-complex]. This is a predicate on the supplied complex, not a choice or an existence assertion of a representative, and it is defined also for $a>b$.
